title: the joint state's margin has a closed form; five boundaries fall out of four measured constants, and the 899 breakpoint is a discontinuity rather than a continuation

claims.structure: the prompt bar and the viewport toolbar are two flex SIBLINGS in one `mx-auto shrink-0` row; that row is toolbarWidth + 8 + 225 wide, and the pill is flush to its right end
claims.margin: cx comes from the four constants; margin = cx - rowRight; while the toolbar is uncapped in the narrow family the pill's margin is a CONSTANT because both edges advance one pixel per pixel of width
claims.notClaimed: the boundaries are BRACKETED by the grid, not interpolated; no defect is claimed (643/644: these scroll back into reach); zero source-site assertions

detail.reading: the pill is 225 wide in every cell, and the row and the toolbar both grow with the width — the toolbar stops at 711 while the row does not

detail.whyItMatters: this is why batch 643 saw a toolbar item 'covered by the prompt bar': the two pills share one row and their x ranges intersect when the toolbar overflows its own box. It is not one row painting over another.

detail.theFormula: cx comes from the four constants; margin = cx - (rowLeft + rowBoxWidth)

detail.theReason: the pill sits at the row's right end, so it moves with the row; while the toolbar is not yet capped its own growth is invisible to the pill's position, and both edges advance one pixel per pixel of width

detail.mechanism: at the family break the row's left inset jumps 12 -> 293 and its width jumps W-24 -> W-586, so the row narrows by ~562 while the pills stay where they are; the margin does not continue, it restarts

detail.reading: a single monotone decay law would be easier to assert and would also be WRONG: the joint set empties out inside the narrow family and comes back at the family break
